name: Glances — Status
description: Live system stats from a Glances instance: CPU / RAM / disk / load / uptime, with a tone-coded state pill that swings from ok → warn → danger as the headline metric crosses thresholds. Each cell targets its own Glances server so a dashboard can monitor several boxes side by side.

cell_options.name: base_url
cell_options.label: Glances URL
cell_options.help: Base URL of the Glances REST server (the host that runs `glances -w`). Tesserae appends /api/4/all itself. For HTTP-Basic auth, embed credentials: http://user:pass@host:61208.

cell_options.name: label
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: Shown in the title bar. Leave blank to fall back to the Glances hostname.
